goal: Prevent draft-gate failures caused by requirement-like draft QA entries that omit requirement priority markers.

analysis.problem: The draft procedure can create requirement-like QA and scope text without `must`, `should`, or `nice-to-have` priority markers. When the draft gate applies the `prioritize-requirements` guardrail, those missing markers can fail the gate even though the missing priority could have been prevented earlier.
analysis.proposedApproach: Update the draft QA guidance to require priority markers on requirement-like draft entries, and update draft-gate guidance to check for missing priority markers before running `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft`.
analysis.validation: The issue names draft QA priority omission as the root cause and asks for both draft-time priority assignment and a pre-gate missing-priority check. The relevant prompt sources are `src/flow/prompts/partials/draft-qa-rules.md`, `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft.md`, and `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md`.

knownFacts: Issue #358 reports that requirement-like QA entries lacked priority markers and caused `prioritize-requirements` draft-gate failures.
`sdd-forge flow get guardrail draft` states that when requirements number more than three items, each requirement needs one priority: `must`, `should`, or `nice-to-have`.
`src/flow/prompts/partials/draft-qa-rules.md` is included by the draft prompt and defines shared QA creation rules.
`src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` defines the pre-gate procedure before `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft`.
decisionPoints: must: Shared draft QA rules must tell agents to attach `must`, `should`, or `nice-to-have` to requirement-like draft entries when generating draft artifacts.
must: Draft-gate guidance must include a pre-gate scan for requirement-like draft text that lacks one of the accepted priority markers.
should: The change should live in shared prompt text so rendered next-action instructions inherit the guidance without duplicating implementation logic.
should: Tests should verify both source prompt text and rendered next-action output.
resolvedByProjectRules: No external dependencies may be added; prompt and test changes can use existing Node.js built-ins.
`src/skills/` changes require `sdd-forge upgrade`, but this issue can be resolved through `src/flow/prompts/` unless review identifies generated skill text that must change.
The alpha policy allows direct prompt contract changes without backward-compatibility shims.
deferredToSpec: Exact wording of prompt guidance and spec-local test assertions can be chosen during spec and implementation as long as the priority contract is observable.

in: must: Add draft QA guidance requiring requirement-like entries in draft artifacts to carry one accepted priority marker: `must`, `should`, or `nice-to-have`.
must: Add draft-gate preflight guidance to scan draft requirement-like text for missing accepted priority markers before running the draft gate.
should: Cover rendered next-action instructions so agents see the new priority procedure during normal flow execution.
should: Add focused tests that fail if the draft priority creation guidance or draft-gate missing-priority check disappears.
out: nice-to-have: Do not change the guardrail article text unless implementation proves the article itself is incorrect.
nice-to-have: Do not add a new persisted draft JSON field for priority unless existing prompt-level markers cannot satisfy the gate.
nice-to-have: Do not change spec requirement priority schema or spec-gate behavior.

impactOnExisting: must: Draft authors receive explicit priority-marker instructions before creating requirement-like draft QA or scope text.
must: Draft-gate operators receive an explicit preflight check that catches missing priority markers before invoking the AI gate.
should: Existing draft QA lifecycle fields and approval metadata behavior remain unchanged.

qa.question: Should this fix add a new persisted priority field to draft QA entries instead of using existing requirement priority markers in draft text?
qa.answer: Recommendation: do not add a new persisted priority field. Use the existing `must`, `should`, and `nice-to-have` priority markers in requirement-like draft text.
qa.evidence: Issue #358 asks for `must`, `should`, and `nice-to-have` priority markers, and `sdd-forge flow get guardrail draft` defines those markers for prioritized requirements.
qa.why: The issue is caused by missing procedural guidance, not by missing draft schema capacity. Prompt-level guidance keeps the fix scoped to draft creation and pre-gate checks.
qa.considered: Adding a persisted QA priority field was considered, but it would change the draft schema and exceed the requested marker-based fix.

approval.notes: Coverage review passed and no unresolved user decision remains.
